query: WITH doomed AS ( SELECT t.id FROM tracks t WHERE t.origin = 'local' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_files mf WHERE mf.track_id = t.id AND mf.folder_id = ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_files mf WHERE mf.track_id = t.id AND (mf.folder_id IS NULL OR mf.folder_id <> ?)) ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doomed) AS tracks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_feedback f JOIN doomed d ON d.id = f.entity_id WHERE f.entity_kind = 'track' AND f.value = 'like') AS likes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN doomed d ON d.id = pt.track_id) AS playlist_entries
